subject: MAP recap: Acme Corp evaluation & next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Bethany Turner <bethany.turner@acme.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP recap: Acme Corp evaluation & next steps

Hi Bethany —

Thanks for the productive call earlier. Quick recap from our side and proposed mutual action plan (MAP) so we can keep momentum: 

Key pain points you confirmed:
- Latency spikes on peak search loads (p95 ~ 900ms) impacting conversions
- Rising inference cost per query and flat ROI from current caching approach
- Need for predictable SLAs for the upcoming pilot with the North America sales team

Goals we discussed:
- Reduce p95 latency to under 300ms for critical paths
- Cut per-query inference cost by ~30% through batching + quantization recommendations
- Stand up a pilot environment with a 6-week cadence for evaluation and decision

Stakeholders (from our call):
- Bethany Turner (Head of Engineering, Acme) — decision influencer
- Sam Lopez (Director, Search) — technical owner for test cases and acceptance criteria
- Marissa Cole (Redwood) — AE / program lead
- Aditya Rao (Redwood) — SE for pilot kickoff and architecture
- Neha Kapoor (Redwood) — solutions engineer / eval owner

Proposed MAP milestones & dates:
1) Pilot kickoff: environment & test data exchange — Target: 2027-07-27
2) Pilot run (2–3 weeks): performance & cost validation — Target: 2027-08-10
3) Final review & recommendation — Target: 2027-08-17
4) Exec decision & contract finalize — Target: 2027-08-31

Next steps (action owners):
- Bethany / Sam: share sample production traces and the acceptance test cases by EOD 7/23 (external)
- Aditya: draft pilot runbook and infra checklist by 7/22 (internal)
- Neha: prepare quantization/config suggestions and a preliminary cost estimate by 7/25 (internal)
- Marissa: schedule weekly syncs (30m) and send MAP file — I’ll attach the working MAP in XLSX now

I attached a working MAP (ACME-MAP-v2.xlsx) and a short pricing estimate for the pilot. If this looks good I’ll lock the pilot kickoff for 7/27 and loop in legal for a short SOW.

Thanks again — excited to get this moving.

—
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
(415) 555-0137

Attachments: ACME-MAP-v2.xlsx, redwood-pricing-estimate.pdf

From: Bethany Turner <bethany.turner@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Sam Lopez <slopez@acme.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2027 15:45:12 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP recap: Acme Corp evaluation & next steps

Thanks Marissa — this is exactly what we needed. A couple of quick notes: 

- Confirmed: we can get sample traces (focused on the checkout and search flows) over to you by Friday 7/23. Sam will own that.
- For acceptance criteria, we’ll define p95 < 300ms on the checkout path and cost per query delta <= -25% relative to our current baseline.
- The pilot window of ~2 weeks works for us; Sam suggested adding a short load test week after the initial run to validate autoscaling behavior. 

I’ll review the MAP with Sam and upload any edits to your Google sheet (will flag changes). We’ll also attach a short network diagram and a list of blocked third-party services (should help Aditya).

One ask: can Redwood provide a short summary of required IAM/networking rules for the pilot? If Aditya or Neha can draft that this week it’ll help legal/infra avoid delays.

Looking forward to the kickoff.

—
Bethany Turner
Head of Engineering, Acme Corp
bethany.turner@acme.com
